title: An immersion into a separated scheme over a base is separated over that base
statement: Let $Z,P,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $i:Z\to P$ be an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $p:P\to S$ be a separated morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Then $p\circ i:Z\to S$ is separated. No quasi-compactness or finite-type assumption is required.
